name: Patricia of End
original_name: パトリシア・オブ・エンド
source:
The Princess of the Netherworld. She came to the surface to destroy it, but fell ill after experiencing the abundant life around her. Luckily Nora was there to save her. Recently she's been reading picture books to children in the neighborhood.

“It’s wonderful how many legends there are on the surface that still I don't know.”
